contributions.detail: exact - 250.00 + 130.01 + 175.16 + 525.00 + 100.00 = 1,180.17, matching BOTH the boxed '>$50' total and the module's stated cover figure. The '<=$50' box is $0.00, so on this split50 sheet there is no unitemized aggregate residual at all. NOTE THE IN-KIND SHAPE: line 4 'Carla Wright/in kind' $525.00 is written INLINE in the itemized contribution schedule and is INCLUDED in the schedule's own printed $1,180.17 - this form variant prints NO separate in-kind schedule and NO separate in-kind total. The row is therefore NOT flagged in_kind=True: doing so would exclude 525.00 from itemized_contrib_sum and manufacture a 655.17-vs-1,180.17 reconciliation failure out of the form's own structure (the exact failure build_finance.py's in-kind block exists to avoid). The in-kind fact is preserved verbatim in donor_raw and in the row note.

expenditures.detail: exact - 250.00 + 130.01 + 175.16 + 525.00 + 100.00 = 1,180.17 against the boxed 'Total amount of expenditures' $1,180.17. The filer booked the Carla Wright in-kind on BOTH sides (as a $525.00 contribution and as a $525.00 'Social Media' expenditure), which is why contributions, expenditures and the cover all read 1,180.17 and the ending balance is $0.00.

_meta_itemized.notes: Typed sheets, portrait, clean scan (index text_quality=high) but the embedded OCR layer is garbled on the amount column, so every figure here comes from the full-page image read, not from draft.py. Mailing addresses and zip codes are printed on the contribution sheet and are DISCARDED AT READ TIME per the privacy rule - only city/state are kept; the addresses were supplied by the filer and are NOT county-redacted. NEW SOURCE PROPERTY (2018 split50 family): in-kind contributions are entered as ordinary inline ledger lines marked '/in kind' in the name cell and are counted inside the schedule's single printed total - unlike the 2024 form family, which prints a separate in-kind schedule with its own total outside the cover figure.
